name: settings page: the detail shows the whole description; J/K scroll it, the focus stays

settings.name: poll
settings.description: How often the rows refresh. A shorter wait shows changes sooner and costs more calls; a longer one is quieter. The first refresh runs when the page opens, whatever the wait. Zero turns the refresh off: the rows then change only when you reload them. Values below one second are rounded up to one second so a typo cannot flood the daemon.
